qualification: Exact-source JUnit matching only. Required CI, independent scope review, actual merge and deployed readback are separate gates. No skipped case is counted as PASS.
serialization_qualification: The 65 selectors match 67 serialized JUnit parent/parameterized testcases. Successful unittest subtests are folded into their parent testcase; the aggregate JUnit tests count includes successful subtest reports. No individually serialized success node is invented. The matcher rejects failure, error or skipped children on every matched testcase. All source reports contain zero failures/errors, and all selected parent/parameterized testcases contain zero skipped children.
